This is a list of notable businesswomen from [[India]].

<!--Entries in this list should be notable with a Wikipedia article written first, or have an independent reliable source with some coverage to establish likely notability (see also WP:CSC, WP:GNG and WP:WTAF).-->
==Banking and finance==
*[[Archana Bhargava]], Chairman and Managing Director, [[United Bank of India]]<ref name=ref2>{{cite web | title=Why banking mints the most women CEOs in India |url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/news-by-industry/jobs/why-banking-mints-the-most-women-ceos-in-india/articleshow/23479513.cms |publisher=The Economic Times |date=4 Oct 2013  |first1=Sreeradha D. |last1=Basu |first2=Rica |last2=Bhattacharyya |accessdate=8 Oct 2013}}</ref> 
*[[Arundhati Bhattacharya]], Chairperson, [[State Bank of India]] (since October 7, 2013)<ref>{{cite web | title=Arundhati Bhattacharya becomes first woman to head SBI |url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/news-by-company/corporate-announcement/arundhati-bhattacharya-becomes-first-woman-to-head-sbi/articleshow/23654361.cms |publisher=The Economic Times |date=8 Oct 2013<!--, 04.00AM IST-->  |author=ET Bureau |accessdate=8 Oct 2013}}</ref> - now retired
*[[Bala Deshpande]], MD, [[New Enterprise Associates]] India 
*[[Chanda Kochhar]] (born 1961), [[ICICI Bank]] Former MD and CEO
*[[Chitra Ramkrishna]], Former Managing Director and CEO, [[National Stock Exchange of India]]
*[[Kalpana Morparia]], CEO of South Asia and India Operations at [[JPMorgan Chase]]
*[[Manisha Girotra]], CEO, [[Moelis & Company|Moelis India]]
*[[Naina Lal Kidwai]], Group General Manager and Country Head of [[HSBC]] India
*[[Renuka Ramnath]], founder of Multiples Alternate Asset Management
*[[Shikha Sharma]] (born 1960), [[AXIS Bank]] Former CEO - now retired
*[[Snehlata Shrivastava]], Executive Director, National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development<ref>{{ cite web | url =  https://www.nabard.org/english/BOD.aspx  | title=  Board of Directors | publisher = NABARD, Official Website | accessdate = 30 November 2013}}</ref>
*[[Usha Sangwan]], Managing Director, [[Life Insurance Corporation of India]]

==Real estate and construction==
*[[Sheila Sri Prakash]], Chief Architect and Founder of [[Shilpa Architects]]; Independent Board Director of [[Chennai Smart Cities Ltd]] and Chairperson of the Board of Directors of Nirmana Investments

==Books, art and media==
*[[Shobhana Bhartia]] (born 1957), Chairperson and Editorial Director of the [[Hindustan Times|Hindustan Times Group]]
*[[Ekta Kapoor]] (born 1975), TV and movie producer, Joint Managing Director and Creative Director of [[Balaji Telefilms]]
*[[Ritu Kumar]] (born 1944), fashion designer
*[[Zarina Mehta]], Chief Creative Officer of Broadcasting at [[UTV Software Communications|UTV]]
*[[Chiki Sarkar]], publisher, [[Penguin Books]] India
*[[Ashvini Yardi]], Programming Head of TV channel [[Colors (TV channel)|Colors]]
* [[Tanya Mittal]] (born 1995), fashion designer, Chief Executive Officer of [[HandMadeLove]]

==Equipment==
*[[Tanya Dubash]], Executive Director and President (Marketing) of [[Godrej Group]]
*[[Sulajja Firodia Motwani]], Joint Managing Director of [[Kinetic Engineering Limited|Kinetic Engineering]]
*[[Lila Poonawalla]], former CEO of [[Alfa Laval]] India and [[TetraPak]] India
*[[Mallika Srinivasan]] (born 1959), CEO of [[TAFE Tractors|Tafe Motors And Tractors Limited]]

==Food  and beverages==
*[[Vinita Bali]] (born 1955), former MD of [[Britannia Industries]] Limited
*[[Indra Nooyi]] (born 1955), Former Chairman and CEO of [[PepsiCo]]

==Health  and medicine==
*[[Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw]] (born 1953), Chairman and Managing Director of [[Biocon]]
*[[Swati Piramal]], Vice Chairperson, [[Piramal Enterprises Ltd|Piramal Enterprises]]
*[[Preetha Reddy]], Managing Director of [[Apollo Hospitals Group]]
*[[Ameera Shah]], CEO and Managing Director, Metropolis Healthcare
*[[Namita Thapar]], Executive Director, Emcure Pharmaceuticals Limited 

==Hotels and catering==
*[[Priya Paul]] (born 1967), Chairperson of Apeejay Surrendra [[The Park Hotels|Park Hotels]]

==Information technology==
*[[Divya Jain]], founder of dLoop
*[[Aruna Jayanthi]], CEO India [[Capgemini]]
*[[Roshni Nadar]] (born 1972), Executive Director and CEO of [[HCL Corporation]]

==Others==
*[[Meena Ganesh]], CEO and Managing Director, Pearson Education Services
*[[Jyoti Gogte]] (born 1956), Indian entrepreneur
*[[Nyrika C. Holkar]], executive director of Godrej & Boyce, a part of the Godrej Enterprises Group
*[[Nabomita Mazumdar]], businesswoman
*[[Zia Mody]] (born 1956), legal consultant, managing partner of [[AZB & Partners]]
*[[Smriti Nagpal]], CEO of Atulyakala
*[[Leena Nair]] (born 1969), Executive Director, HR, [[Hindustan Unilever]]
*[[Lavanya Nalli]], vice chairman of Nalli Group of Companies
*[[Rajani Pandit]], founder of the Rajani Investigative Bureau
*[[Sheetal Agashe]] (born 1977), [[managing director]] of [[Brihans Natural Products]]<ref>{{cite book |title=[[Femina (India)|Femina]] presents Pune's Most Powerful 2018-19 |date=2019 |publisher=[[Worldwide Media]] |last=Sathe-Patwardhan |first=Radhika |editor-last=Chaitanya |editor-first=Tanya |chapter=The Boss Lady: Sheetal Agashe, MD, Brihans Natural Products |location=[[Mumbai]] |type=[[Coffee table book]] |pages=64–65 |id=[http://rni.nic.in/T_Appl_Status_LetterDownload/Title_Application_Status.aspx RNI 6253/59]}}</ref>
